exact: exogenous peptide antigen processing and presentation via MHC class II
broad: antigen presentation, exogenous antigen via MHC class II
antigen processing, exogenous antigen via major histocompatibility complex class II

definition: The process in which an antigen-presenting cell expresses a peptide antigen of exogenous origin on its cell surface in association with an MHC class II protein complex. The peptide antigen is typically, but not always, processed from a whole protein.
label: MHC class II antigen presentation
